nature: one bounded study, one setting; broad reversal family (not claimed statistically independent); market-ADJUSTED signal, NOT a hedged/market-neutral book; research only; no engine/runtime/UI/key/account change; consumedDEV only

universe.eligibility: D01 PIT at the hour (30d median quote volume >= $10m, >= 720 consecutive bars)

features.return: ln(c_t/c_{t-1}) only if the prior hour bar exists; no forward fill
features.market: leave-one-out equal-weight mean of OTHER coins eligible at t with finite r; >= 8 others else missing
features.fit: OLS with intercept r_i,s on m_i,s, s in [t-168h, t-1h], >= 120 matched finite pairs, market variance > 1e-18; no clipping
features.innovation: e = r - alpha_t - beta_t*m_t with each hour's own prior fit
features.sigma: population std (ddof 0) of e over [t-168h, t-1h], >= 120 finite, > 0
features.entry_rule: long z <= -3, short z >= +3 (levels); skip |m_{t-2}+m_{t-1}+m_t| >= 0.015 (log); candidate eligible at t

trade.entry: next 1h OPEN at t+1h (decision = signal bar close); missing -> refused
trade.stop: 3.0 x Wilder ATR14(1h) of the signal bar from the entry fill
trade.gap: adverse open beyond stop (not the first bar) -> exit at open

execution.harness: research/x2wide/run_x2wide.py a525ed69 sha256 8251f9b3... imported unchanged; only run_lot replaced
execution.costs: 7/15/23 bp per side (2 bp slip + 5/13/21 bp fee) + funding proxy 1bp/8h on every held 1h close incl. exit bar

gates.pass_means: candidate for independent verification and future protected PAPER evidence only; never a mainnet qualification

report: all arms/costs/orders, gross and net decomposition, long/short, coin concentration, frequency, drawdown, early/later

tests.mutation: 16 key-line mutants: 15 killed (1 after an added assertion); gap-at-entry-bar mutant is equivalent (entry at that open cannot be beyond its own stop)

limitations: funding stress proxy, not native signed funding
